Chapter 1200 - 17 Fu Xu Heavenly Venerate (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1200: Chapter 17 Fu Xu Heavenly Venerate (Request for Subscription)_2

...

Thunderclap Ancient Country.

As one of the six major ancient countries, the strong ones of Thunderclap Ancient Country were fundamentally born from thunder. It is said that the Thunder Origin Ancestor was the first being to come to life from thunder in this Fang Yuan World.

Later, he was accepted as a disciple by the Da Fu Ancestor and eventually stepped into the thirteenth layer, founding the Thunderclap Ancient Country.

"In this treasure land competition, if possible, we will naturally seize this treasure land. If not, we will secretly help the Barbaric Wilderness Country to take the treasure land."

The leading Peak Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country said.

The Barbaric Wilderness Country and Thunderclap Ancient Country have a close relationship. Although the Thunder Origin Ancestor broke away to establish the Thunderclap Ancient Country, the ties with the Barbaric Wilderness Country were never severed.

"No problem."

The other Peak Venerables of Thunderclap Ancient Country nodded.

The competition for the treasure land is limited to two thousand years. After two thousand years, whoever has the most ’cores’ of the treasure land refined will gain the ruling rights to it.

If Thunderclap Ancient Country ends up refining too few ’cores’ of the treasure land, not even making it into the top three, they will secretly transfer the treasure land ’cores’ to the Heavenly Venerables of the Barbaric Wilderness Country.

Doing so would at least recover some loss, preventing the Barbaric Wilderness Country from acquiring the treasure land ’cores’ for nothing.

In fact, not only Thunderclap Ancient Country does this. Once other ancient countries realize the ’cores’ of the treasure land they refined have no chance of taking first place, they will sell them at various ’prices’.

It’s just that the Thunderclap Ancient Country, being close to the Barbaric Wilderness Country, would prioritize selling to them.

"I wonder, which Heavenly Venerables will the Barbaric Wilderness Country send this time?" The leading Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country glanced around. Currently, the Heavenly Venerables of the five major ancient countries have all arrived, only the Barbaric Wilderness Country remains absent.

...

Barbaric Wilderness Country.

Twelve tall figures stood there, with time and space slightly disintegrating around them.

"Among the six major ancient countries, the Barbaric Wilderness Country has the most first-class treasure lands."

The leading Peak Venerable looked around, "And our Barbaric Wilderness Country occupies the fewest first-class treasure lands, with only about a dozen."

A first-class treasure land produces rare resources that are highly beneficial to Heavenly Venerables. Occupying more first-class treasure lands might not show immediate impact, but over time, the effect is significant.

Why does the Barbaric Wilderness Country have the strongest overall strength and the most in number?

Is it because of the Da Fu Ancestor? Among the six ancient countries, the ancestors seldom interfere unless something significant occurs.

The ancestors of many ancient countries left behind numerous inherited secret techniques and era-affiliated remnants; otherwise, there are not many differences.

The history of the Barbaric Wilderness Country is the most ancient, naturally giving rise to more Heavenly Venerables. This is indeed a reason, but not the main one.

The Barbaric Wilderness Country’s strength is such because it occupies the most treasure lands, especially first-class ones. The Barbaric Wilderness Country holds nearly a third of this source world’s first-class treasure lands.

Occupying so many first-class treasure lands that are immensely beneficial to Heavenly Venerables makes it difficult for the Barbaric Wilderness Country not to be strong.

"Therefore—"

The leading Peak Venerable of the Barbaric Wilderness Country continued, "This newly born first-class treasure land is imperative for our Barbaric Wilderness Country."

Currently, to acquire new treasure lands, a country needs to initiate full-scale warfare with other ancient countries, seizing the area where the opponent’s first-class treasure land is located.

In doing so, they can naturally obtain the ruling rights to the corresponding first-class treasure land.

But it is extremely difficult.

Full-scale warfare between ancient countries can range from small to large.

If small, only a few Heavenly Venerable-level experts will be dispatched, with minor clashes;

At best involving the gain or loss of tens to hundreds of major regions.

However, in a large-scale full war, it becomes terrifying, with Heavenly Venerables and Peak Venerables continuously taking action, capable of shattering the heavens and earth.

Compared to such full-scale warfare, this competition for a newly born first-class treasure land is much milder.

At least, the time is limited to only two thousand years, and each ancient country involves only twelve Peak Venerables.

The key point is that in the quest for a first-class treasure land, it’s not just about strength but also about luck. With good luck, you can casually find a pile of treasure land ’cores’.

Besides luck, it also depends on financial power.

For example, during the final moments of the treasure land competition, when other ancient countries see that their refined treasure land ’cores’ cannot contend for first place, they will ’sell off’ treasure land cores. At this time, as long as you can afford the price, you can completely buy them.

If the Barbaric Wilderness Country can afford the price, there’s a significant chance to seize this first-class treasure land.

Of course, even if it’s possible to buy treasure land ’cores’ through financial power, they must strive to acquire more treasure land ’cores’ on their own to minimize costs.

The Barbaric Wilderness Country is eager for this newly born first-class treasure land but not foolish.

...

Hum!

Just as the many Peak Venerables of the five major ancient countries were waiting patiently to enter the treasure land, a sudden fluctuation of time and space swiftly arrived, drawing all Peak Venerables’ attention to its source.

"What is that?" Lin Yuan also opened his eyes. At present, all the Peak Venerables of the five major ancient countries had assembled, only the most mysterious, Barbaric Wilderness Country, was absent.

Time and space spread like ripples in all directions.

Twelve figures emerged from the depths of space-time, led by a man in a dark robe. He stood silently, not exuding any aura, suppressing the eleven Peak Venerables behind him.

It seemed the man in the dark robe was the center of this space-time, with other existences being mere supporting roles, dependent on the dark-robed man.

"So powerful." Lin Yuan was secretly shocked. The man in the dark robe gave him a feeling similar to that of the Demonic Jade Tower Master.

Of course, no comparison to Xuanhuang. The last time Lin Yuan saw Xuanhuang, he forcibly broke free from the time loop, equivalent to stepping half a step towards the thirteenth layer.

"The strength of an Invincible Great Saint?" Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

Whether it be the Red-eyed Venerable, Venerable Guanglie, Venerable Hengyang, or several other Peak Venerables from different ancient countries, they were only close to the Invincible Great Saint level. But the dark-robed man was undoubtedly an Invincible Great Saint.

The Invincible Great Saint here refers to the Invincible Great Saint of the Chaos Void.

As for this Fang Yuan world? It might not count as an Invincible Great Saint. With feedback from multiple thirteenth-layer ancestors, more than one Invincible Great Saint-level power has surely been born. With more than one, it’s not invincible.

"Hahaha, everyone, my Barbaric Wilderness Country is late. I hope you can forgive us," the man in the dark robe smiled slightly, speaking to the other Peak Venerables of the five major ancient countries.

His voice seemed to have a strange infectiousness, causing idle Great Lords watching from afar to feel as though their thoughts were being distorted.

The Peak Venerables of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Barbaric Wilderness Country, Xuanyin Ancient Country, and other ancient countries frowned slightly.

"Is it Fu Xu Venerate?"

"Fu Xu Venerate’s strength surpasses the top Peak Venerables. Is the Barbaric Wilderness Country placing great importance on this treasure land?"

"Wasn’t it said that Fu Xu Venerate was preparing to break through to that level? Why is he here?"

One by one, the top Peak Venerables felt the pressure, especially the Peak Venerables of Thunderclap Ancient Country. They were determined to get the first-class treasure land, but facing Fu Xu Venerate?

Forces started feeling the pressure rising. Especially the Peak Venerables of Thunderclap Ancient Country, it felt overwhelming.

"No need to feel pressured."

Red Flame Venerable surveyed around, "For this first-class treasure land, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has made sure that I brought some of the foundation to the fore."

Even if it’s possible to buy treasure land ’cores’ through financial means, they will surely try to obtain as many treasure land ’cores’ as possible on their own, so as to pay the least cost.

Although the Barbaric Wilderness Country is eager for this newly born first-class treasure land, they are not foolish.

...

Buzz!

Just as the many Peak Venerables of the five major ancient countries were patiently waiting to enter the treasure land, a sudden spatial fluctuation rapidly approached, drawing all the Peak Venerables’ attention toward the source of the disturbance.

"What is that?" Lin Yuan likewise opened his eyes. At present, the Peak Venerables of the five major ancient countries had all arrived, only the most mysterious Barbaric Wilderness Country remaining.

Time and space rippled outward in all directions like ripples.

Twelve figures emerged from the depths of space-time, led by a man in a dark robe, who stood silently, emitting no aura but still suppressing the eleven Peak Venerables standing behind him.

It seemed that this man in the dark robe was standing in the void, yet paradoxically overshadowed the other Peak Venerables present.

"Haha, everyone, it’s a pleasure to meet you," said Fu Xu with a subtle infectious melody in his voice, as he addressed the other Peak Venerables.

All eyes turned to the man in the dark robe, who seemed to be the center of an expanding spatial ripple spreading in all directions.

Even Lin Yuan opened his eyes, noting that now all the Peak Venerables from the five major ancient countries had gathered, except for the most mysterious Da Fu Ancient Country.

Just then, a distortion in space rippled outward rapidly, drawing the gaze of all the Peak Venerables to its origin.

From the depths of space, twelve figures emerged, led by a man in a dark robe, standing quietly without emitting the slightest aura, yet overshadowing the eleven Peak Venerables behind him.

It seemed that this man in the dark robe gave the impression of having crossed half a step beyond the twelfth layer.

"An invincible Great Saint," Lin Yuan thought to himself, recognizing the man in the dark robe. Though in this Fang Yuan World, he probably wouldn’t count as invincible.

"Hahaha, gentlemen, I wonder which Heavenly Venerables the great Da Fu Country will send this time to contend for the treasure territory?" the leading Peak Venerable of Thunderclap Ancient Country had scanned the surroundings, noting that the Heavenly Venerables of the five great ancients were all present, with only Da Fu Ancient Country remaining.

Time and space rippled outward in waves.

Twelve figures emerged from the depths of time-space, with a man in a dark robe leading them, standing quietly. He didn’t emanate a trace of aura, yet he seemed to suppress the eleven Peak Venerables behind him.
